verses: Qasam hai bikherney waliyon ki ura ker
Phir uthaney waliyan bojh ko
Phir chalney waliyan narmi say
Phir kaam ko taqseem kerney waliyan
Yaqeen mano kay tum say jo waday kiye jatay hain (sab) sachay hain
Aur be-shak insaf honey wala hai
Qasam hai raahon walay aasman ki
Yaqeenan tum mukhtalif baat mein paray huye ho
Uss say o hi baaz rakha jata hai jo pher diya gaya ho
Bey sanad baaten kerney walay ghaarat ker diye gaye
Jo ghaflat mein hain aur bhoolay huye hain
Poochtay hain kay yaum jaza kab hoga?
Haan yeh woh din hai kay yeh aag per tapaye jayen gay
Apni fitna perdaazi ka maza chakho, yehi hai jiss ki tum jaldi macha rahey thay
Be-shak taqwa walay log bahishton aur chashmon mein hun gay
Unn kay rab ney jo kuch unhen ata farmaya hai ussay ley rahey hun gay woh to uss say pehlay hi nekokaar thay
Woh raat ko boht kum soya kertay thay
Aur waqt waqt-e-sahar istaghfaar kiya kertay thay
Aur unn kay maal mein mangney walon ka aur sawal say bachney walon ka haq tha
Aur yaqeen walon kay liye to zamin mein boht si nishaniyan hain
Aur khud tumhari zaat mein bhi, to kiya tum dekhtay nahi ho
Aur tumhari rozi aur jo tum say wada kiya jata hai sab aasman mein hai
Aasman o zamin kay perwerdigar ki qasam! kay yeh bilkul bar-haq hai aisa hi jaisay kay tum baaten kertay ho
Kiya tujhay Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) kay moazziz mehmanon ki khabar bhi phonchi hai?
Woh jab unn kay haan aaye to salam kiya, Ibrahim ney jawab salam diya (aur kaha yeh to) ajnabi log hain
Phir (chup chaap jaldi jaldi) apney ghar walon ki taraf gaye aur aik farba bachray (ka gosht) laye
Aur ussay unn kay pass rakha aur kaha aap khatay kiyon nahi
Phir to dil hi dil mein unn say khofzada hogaye unhon ney kaha aap khof na kijiye. Aur unhon ney uss (hazrat Ibrahim) ko aik ilm walay larkay ki bisharat di
Pus unn ki biwi aagay barhi aur heyrat mein aaker apney mun per hath maar ker kaha kay mein to burhiya hun aur sath hi baanjh
Unhon ney kaha haan teray perwerdigar ney ussi tarah farmaya hai, be-shak woh hakeem o aleem hai
(hazrat ibrahim alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay Allah kay bhejay huye (farishto!) tumhara kiya maqsad hai?
Unhon ney jawab diya kay hum gunah gaar qom ki taraf bhejay gaye hain
Takay hum unn per mitti kay kankar barsaeen
Jo teray rab ki taraf say nishan zada hain, unn hadd say guzar janey walon kay liye
Pus jitney eman walay o haan thay hum ney unhen nikal liya
Aur hum ney o haan musalmanon ka sirf aik hi ghar paya
Aur o haan hum ney unn kay liye jo dard naak azab ka darr rakhtay hain aik (kamil) alamat chori
Musa (alaihi as-salam kay qissay) mein (bhi humari taraf say tanbeeh hai) kay hum ney ussay Firaun ki taraf khulli daleel dey ker bheja
Pus uss apnay bal botay per mun mora aur kehney laga yeh jadoogar hai ya deewana hai
Bil-aakhir hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkaron ko apney azab mein pakar ker darya mein daal diya woh tha hi malamat kay qabil
Ussi tarah aadiyon mein bhi (humari taraf say tanbeeh hai) jab kay hum ney unn per khair o barkat say khali aandhi bheji
Woh jiss jiss cheez per girti thi ussay boseedah hadi ki tarah (choora choora) kerdeti thi
Aur samood (kay qissay) mein bhi (ibrat) hai jab unn say kaha gaya kay tum kuch dino tak faeedah utha lo
Lekin unhon ney apney rab kay hukum say sirtabi ki jiss per unhen unn kay dekhtay dekhtay (tez tund) karakay ney halak ker diya
Pus na to woh kharay ho sakay aur na badla ley sakay
Aur Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ki qom ka bhi uss say pehlay (yehi haal ho chuka tha) woh bhi baray nafarman log thay
Aasman ko hum ney (apney) hathon say banaya hai aur yaqeenan hum kushadgi kerney walay hain
Aur zamin ko hum ney farash bana diya hai pus hum boht hi achay bichanay walay hain
Aur her cheez ko hum ney jora jora peda hai takay tum naseehat hasil kero
Pus tum Allah ki taraf dor bhaag (yani rujoo) kero, yaqeenan mein tumhen uss ki taraf say saaf saaf tanbeeh kerney wala hun
Aur Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood na thehrao. Be-shak mein tumhen uss ki taraf say khulla daraney wala hun
Ussi tarah jo log unn say pehlay guzray hain unn kay pass jo bhi rasool aaya unhon ney keh diya kay ya to yeh jadoogar hai ya deewana hai
Kiya yeh uss baat ki aik doosray ko wasiyat kertay gaye hain
(nahi) balkay)yeh yeh sab kay sab sirkash hain. To aap unn say mun pher len aap per koi malamat nahi
Aur naseehat kertay rahen yaqeenan yeh naseehat eman walon ko nafa dey gi
Mein ney jinnat insanon ko mehaz ussi liye peda kiya hai kay woh sirf meri ibadat keren
Na mein unn say rozi chahata hun na meri yeh chahat hai kay yeh mujhay khilayen
Allah Taalaa to khud hi sab ka rozi rasan tawanaee wala aur zor aawar hai
Pus jin logon ney zulm kiya hai unhen bhi unn kay sathiyon kay hissa kay misil hissa milay ga, lehaza woh mujh say jaldi talab na keren
Pus kharabi hai munkiron ko unn kay uss din ki jiss ka wada diye jatay hain
